B01.title: Push, push, and return
B01.description: Push two Home details, go Back to Detail 1, then return to the root. The visible path follows each navigation step.

B02.title: Switch tab, then push
B02.description: Select Library and open Detail 1 through a single app action, while Home keeps its empty path.

B03.title: Independent tab histories
B03.description: Build different stacks in Home and Library, then switch between them. Each tab returns to its own detail.

B04.title: Prepare an unselected tab
B04.description: Prepare Library’s stack from Home, visit its details, then clear its history and return to Library’s root.

B05.title: Present and dismiss a sheet
B05.description: Open contextual Classes above Home Detail 1, then close the sheet and return to the same Home detail.

B06.title: Replace an open sheet
B06.description: Replace local Classes with Inspector, return to the Classes list, then dismiss the sheet.

B07.title: Replace a sheet from its detail
B07.description: Open Class 3 inside local Classes, replace the sheet with Inspector, then return to Classes at its list root.

B08.title: Local navigation inside a sheet
B08.description: Use app-owned SwiftUI navigation to open Class 3, go Back, open it again, and close the Waypoint-presented sheet.

B09.title: Dismiss and reopen
B09.description: Close local Classes from Class 3, then reopen the sheet. The reopened sheet starts at the Classes list.

B10.title: Replace a sheet with Utility
B10.description: Request Utility from a local Class 3 detail. Utility replaces the sheet content on iPhone; closing it returns to Home.

C01.title: Router-driven navigation in a sheet
C01.description: Push Class 3 through the Classes context router, then go Back. The sheet keeps the same identity as its path changes.

C02.title: Open a class through its parent
C02.description: Request Class 3 from Home. The sheet opens with an initialized Classes → Class 3 stack, and Back reveals the Classes list.

C03.title: Open a class directly
C03.description: Choose Direct detail and request Class 3. It opens as the sheet’s root page; closing it returns to Home.

C04.title: Reuse the existing context
C04.description: Open Classes, then request Class 3 and Class 4 through the root controls. Both pushes use the same sheet identity and context.

C05.title: Present a nested sheet
C05.description: Present a child Inspector from Class 3. Close the child to reveal the same Class 3 stack, then close Classes to return to Home.

C06.title: Route through the root override
C06.description: Invoke the demo’s root override while Class 3 is open. Classes dismisses, Library becomes selected, and Detail 99 appears.

W04.title: Editor fallback on iPhone
W04.description: Edit a draft in the sheet fallback, review it, and reopen it with the text retained. Repeat the unavailable-window request and check that its pending state clears.
